objective: Define the smallest native Verilator parser-stub validation and handoff boundary before any native parser implementation or source patch claim.

parser_stub_boundary.operator_goal: A future native Verilator parser should be able to parse the minimal sidecar GPU options, validate them without relying on wrapper argparse choices, and emit a structured sidecar handoff plan before any execution.

unknown_accelerator_error.message_requirement: must name the unsupported value and list sidecar-gpu as the only accepted accelerator for this boundary

parser_stub_owned_responsibilities: parse --sim-accel and accept only sidecar-gpu in the first native parser-stub boundary
reject unknown accelerator names through the parser-stub validation contract rather than depending on Python argparse choices
require --sim-accel-states and --sim-accel-steps as a positive-integer pair
reject missing shape halves, non-positive counts, and mixed native shape spellings
preserve ordinary Verilator inputs such as --cc, --timing, -Mdir, source files, -f filelists, --top-module, defines, include directories, warning flags, and other Verilator arguments
emit or call a structured sidecar-plan handoff before any build, run, compare, or estimate execution
sidecar_owned_responsibilities_kept_out_: terminal print modes and JSON operator-plan convenience output
structured_handoff_fields: Verilator mdir if supplied or deterministic mdir naming rule
top module if supplied or explicit unresolved top-module status
source files or explicit filelist inputs
defines, include directories, warning flags, and other preserved Verilator args
coverage overlay or coverage top boundary reference supplied by sidecar/template metadata
coverage manifest scope and compared output words supplied by sidecar/template metadata
host-probe build metadata reference supplied by sidecar/template metadata
init state path or deterministic naming rule
reference state path or deterministic naming rule
candidate state path or deterministic naming rule
compare report path or deterministic naming rule

review_command_candidates: review the structured handoff fields against records/scaling_gates/verilator_native_option_parser_boundary_dry_run_result_gate.json
review that unknown accelerator validation is assigned to native_parser_stub_validation_contract, not current argparse choices
review that wrapper-only options remain outside the native parser-stub minimum

required_next_gate.name: review_verilator_native_option_parser_stub_boundary_gate
must_decide: whether unknown accelerator validation is correctly assigned to the parser-stub validation contract
whether using the shared sidecar option mapper for paired shape validation is acceptable while current argparse choices remain wrapper-only
whether the structured handoff fields are sufficient for a future non-executing parser stub fixture
whether the stub avoids source closure, coverage manifest, host-probe metadata, state path, and report path inference
whether the next action may define a non-executing parser-stub fixture or must first refactor wrapper validation
whether the definition avoids native parser implementation, execution, measurement, arbitrary filelist support, dependency inference, automatic allocation, and timing claims

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not parser inference of coverage manifests, host-probe metadata, source closure, state paths, or report paths
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not a new public CLI or workflow
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
